selectedDefects.issueTitle: 0.17.2 has a never ending spinning circle on a new install
selectedDefects.whySuitable: MediaPickerScreen relied on the rememberPermissionState onPermissionResult callback to dispatch OnPermissionAccepted. On a clean install that callback did not fire the way the screen assumed, so the composable stayed in DataState.Loading forever and the user saw a spinner that never resolved. The fix replaces the callback with a LaunchedEffect keyed on permissionState.status.isGranted and hoists the permission branch above the data branch. On the affected build the loading branch is composed before PermissionMissingView, so the system permission dialog is unreachable; on the fixed build the dialog is reachable and accepting it exposes the empty media view. The observable is semantic, not pixel: the affected build retains a progress indicator and never exposes the empty media node, while the fixed build exposes the empty media node. A qualifying replay must drive and read those nodes through Appium UiAutomator2, since a Compose hierarchy reaches UiAutomator2 through the semantics-to-accessibility bridge

selectedDefects.issueTitle: While locking video gives black shade tone
selectedDefects.whySuitable: the player's control overlay was gated on controlsVisibilityState.controlsVisible alone, so locking the controls left the whole scrimmed overlay composed on top of the video. The fix adds && !controlsVisibilityState.controlsLocked to the AnimatedVisibility condition. The observation does not need a pixel comparison: while the controls are locked, the seek bar and transport buttons must be absent from the Compose semantics tree, and on the affected build they are still present behind the scrim. That is a direct exercise of Compose semantics read through UiAutomator2, and it is a different adapter path from the permission defect, which is about state that never advances rather than nodes that never leave
remaining: push a small video file into the AVD's shared storage and grant media permission as part of setup
author the trigger: start playback, reveal the controls, tap lock, then enumerate the semantics tree
state identity and authority: locked player controls must not remain interactive or visible
minimize the trigger and verify neighboring legal behavior: with the controls unlocked, the same nodes are present on both builds
prove three clean affected reproductions and three reached-observation fixed controls

selectedDefects.issueTitle: [BUG] v0.17.2 Autoplay on Single Selected Video Completion
selectedDefects.whySuitable: tapping one video called startPlayback(listOf(uri)), which always attached an API_PLAYLIST extra, so the player treated a single tap as a playlist and rolled on to the next file when it ended. The fix adds a single-uri overload that passes a null playlist. The trigger is an ordinary UiAutomator2 tap on a Compose list item followed by waiting out a short clip, and the observation is which activity and which semantics tree is on screen once playback ends. It exercises the adapter across an Android activity boundary rather than inside one composition, which is the third distinct path among the nextplayer selections
remaining: push two short video files so that a wrong autoplay has somewhere to go, and confirm their MediaStore ordering
author the trigger and bound the wait on playback completion
state identity and authority: playing a single selected item must stop when that item ends
minimize the trigger and verify neighboring legal behavior: a genuine multi-select playback must still advance on both builds
prove three clean affected reproductions and three reached-observation fixed controls

selectedDefects.issueTitle: [Enhancement]: Improve currency picker in onboarding screen to better handle screen rotation
selectedDefects.whySuitable: the currency picker held its selection and its search text in plain remember, so an activity recreation discarded both and the onboarding screen snapped back to the default currency with an empty search field. The fix is precisely rememberSaveable. This is the canonical Compose state-restoration defect and it needs a real device event that only the emulator can deliver, a configuration change, so it exercises the adapter's ability to hold an observation across an Android activity recreation and then re-resolve Compose semantics nodes on the recomposed tree. It is also a second, independent application, and its defect class is state loss rather than state that never advances

selectedDefects.issueTitle: Unable to correctly handle 24-hour and 12-hour time formats
selectedDefects.whySuitable: the deposit and edit-transaction sheets opened a DateTimeDialog with no DateTimeConfig, so the dialog picked up an ambient locale and presented a time format inconsistent with what the rest of the screen rendered. The fix pins DateTimeConfig(locale = Locale.US) at both call sites. The trigger is a device-level setting change followed by a Compose dialog opening, and the observation is the text of the semantics nodes inside that dialog, which is exactly the surface UiAutomator2 reads. It is a weaker candidate than the other four because the observable depends on emulator locale and 24-hour configuration, which is why it is fifth of five rather than one of the first four

author the trigger: create a goal, open the deposit sheet, open the date and time dialog, read the dialog's semantics text
state identity and authority, which here is an authored contract about the application's own formatting consistency rather than a platform rule
